own_example: The stipulated sequence0.8,0.2,0.9 and threshold0.5 are paper inputs, not PCG output. Each toy operation consumes exactly one value; an inserted cosmetic draw changes which value the second attack receives.
limits: No generator, engine, network or benchmark execution.
Separate state objects isolate this specific consumption interference, not statistical independence, thread safety or whole-game determinism.
No cross-library, distribution-version or platform equivalence proof; no raw-memory persistence format.

bounded_rejection_explanation.read_scope: PCG minimal documentation raw/bounded API and fixed pcg_basic.c bounded function. Original GGPO and full-header reading records retained, not repeated this increment.
bounded_rejection_explanation.support_path: 管理档案/支持资料/随机种子没变，为什么第二次攻击的结果变了.md
bounded_rejection_explanation.example: Independent equal-probability values 0 through 7 map modulo 3 with counts 3/3/2; reject raw values below 2 for counts 2/2/2. Constructed prefix 0,1,5 consumes three draws for one result. Not actual PCG output.
bounded_rejection_explanation.limits: Positive representable bound; actual 32-bit bound-3 threshold is 1, not the toy 2. No proof of a fixed iteration/time upper bound, generator quality, cryptographic security or game fairness. No PRNG or game execution.
